name: Takai Ayane
source:
She is a third-year student, senior to the main character, and is a bewitching beauty who is also known as a walking sex symbol. Her name is not a mere pretense, and she is truly out of the ordinary in the way she walks with ease while shaking her huge breasts, which are said to exceed three-digit size at best.

She is aloof and mischievous, teasing the main character, who belongs to the same committee, to make him feel awkward. However, the committee is already useless in a school with loose discipline, and currently there are only two committee members, Ayane and the main character.

In fact, it can be said that there is practically no self-governing action at all, as Ayane herself has taken the initiative in disturbing the public morals of the school.
Although she and the main character have known each other for only half a year or so, they talk to each other as if they were old acquaintances, and Ayane herself seems to be fond of the main character.

She has no specific hobbies, but has a wide range of knowledge and skills. In fact, she is secretly active as a certain goddess who appears on Internet image boards. However, she has no particular intention of hiding it, and she maintains an unconcerned attitude. 

She has an inquisitive mind for sex more than anyone else, and enjoys taking naughty selfies and the like as her instincts take her.
